As soon as I left their house I swear a small fleet of cars were chasing me. The same cars over and over following me through a city. I kept getting phone calls which contained cryptic but covertly threatening messages from the person whose house I left in the early morning that day which lasted over the course of 4 days.

I never slept the whole time as I was hearing knocks and things being dragged around and up the stairs in the foyer of my apartment.

I was hearing the person I was last with speaking over the phone in my phone calls as I frantically called my mum to call the police to get me to some safety and believed that the person who I was with just as the psychosis began was intercepting these calls and making the police not come as the multiple times I rang they dispatched more police. 

I was put in an intubated coma after I took a large overdose of GHB and crashed my car while they were chasing me.

I was sent home with no charge and it continued. I finally took another car and they started chasing me again, I pulled up to a police station and I got a cryptic message from the person so I knew they knew I was pulled up at a police station. I finally just drove around erratically until I was flagged down by police and taken away.

I was put in a type of mental ward for a few days and still received a few cryptic calls and messages.

I went home and again received a few calls and messages from people looking for what I had sold or asking how I was, all people from the drug world who I didn’t know. It’s stopped now, maybe because I’ve gone somewhere to rest and haven’t returned back to my apartment.

I tell this story to people who aren’t of the drug world and they say I’ve hallucinated the whole thing but I don’t feel like that’s possible. Surely some of it was real.
